But here is what they never told you about Hayflick's research:

The limit is not in the cell. It is in the telomere.

When human cells are exposed to low-frequency pulsed electromagnetic fields (PEMF) at 10 Hz, telomerase production increases by 295%.

The telomeres rebuild. The countdown resets. The cell does not die.

This was tested on astronauts to prevent cellular degradation in space. It worked. The astronauts' biological age markers reversed by an average of 8.6 years during the mission.

NASA published the results in an internal technical brief. It was never released to the public medical community.

📌 Tehran, IRNA- The Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) has officially rejected rumors regarding an attack on the Bushehr nuclear power plant, saying the facility is safe and stable, with all units operating without interruption.

The AEOI issued a statement on Sunday in response to recent claims on social media that parts of the Bushehr nuclear power plant had been targeted.
​
“The Bushehr nuclear power plant is in a completely normal, safe, and stable state, and all its units and facilities are operating continuously and in accordance with standard procedures,” the organization said.
​
The statement further emphasized that any official information regarding AEOI facilities, activities, or related events will be disseminated exclusively through the organization’s official communication channels.
